caseNameFull: GEORGE C. BEIDLER v. United States
syllabus:
Judgment was rendered in favor of thb defendants in the court below. On appeal the judgment was affirmed, and the Supreme Court decided:

Patent No. 1057397, granted to George C. Beidler, March 25, 1913, for an improvement in photographing and developing apparatus, does not contain a description of the claimed discovery adequate to render it useful, and is therefore invalid for failure to disclose a practical invention.

opinions.author: Clarke
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Clarke

delivered the opinion of the Supreme Court June 7, 1920.
